name: Conker
description: Horse chestnuts bursting from their spiny green husks, each case split open on one side to show the glossy nut and its pale scar.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { -webkit-transform: translate(@r(-8, 8)%, @r(-8, 8)%) rotate(@r(0, 360)deg) scale(@rn(0.75, 1.05, 3)); transform: translate(@r(-8, 8)%, @r(-8, 8)%) rotate(@r(0, 360)deg) scale(@rn(0.75, 1.05, 3)); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--husk); clip-path: @var(--husk); -webkit-mask: conic-gradient(from 140deg at 50% 50%, #000 0 262deg, transparent 262deg 360deg); mask: conic-gradient(from 140deg at 50% 50%, #000 0 262deg, transparent 262deg 360deg); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 36%; top: 23%; width: 52%; height: 56%; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(34% 64% at 100% 50%, var(--color1) 0 100%, transparent 100%), @p(var(--color5), var(--color6)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
